Ava CS: quick weekly check-in for Kestrel Labs' dedicated pool (ds-us-central-2). noticed a sustained rise in queue depth last night between 02:10-03:30 UTC; peak saturation ~92%. attaching quick metrics and a proposed short-term mitigation. :bar_chart:

metrics-bot: gpu_pool_saturation{pool=\"ds-us-central-2\"} spike to 0.92 at 2026-03-20T02:18Z
metrics-bot: avg_queue_depth{tenant=\"kestrel\"} 78 -> 220 (1h tail)

Ava CS: Prometheus queries I ran:
```
# 1h rolling max GPU util by pool
max_over_time(gpu_utilization_percent{pool=\"ds-us-central-2\"}[1h])
# queue depth for kestrel
avg_over_time(queue_depth{tenant=\"kestrel\"}[30m])
```

Ava CS: quick context — Kestrel is onboarding a new large-retrieval eval this week; they mentioned several concurrent long-context generation jobs in the canary tests. this explains the tail latency bump as well.

Marco SRE: saw the alert. i kicked off a short drain plan for low-priority jobs at 02:45 UTC and adjusted scheduler weights to favor kestrel's reserved slots. started a temporary burst policy for 90 mins (2 GPUs). monitoring. :gear:

Marco SRE: action snippets i pushed to orchestration controller:
```json
{"burst_policy": "ephemeral", "pool": "ds-us-central-2", "add_gpus": 2, "ttl_minutes": 90}
```

Jun (Kestrel): thanks, appreciate the fast response. is that burst charge visible on our bill right away? also can you confirm queue depth target we want to reach? our onboarding run will finish tomorrow morning.

Ava CS: the burst will be billed to the usual reserved+burst meter; i'll send a detailed spend delta post-mortem to your billing contact. target queue depth <= 50 within 30m of burst start, and sustained saturation <80%. if we don't hit that we'll propose increasing their reserved commit before renewal. :money_with_wings:

Marco SRE: current tail latency decreased from 1.4s -> 0.6s after policy change. queue depth slipped to ~48 within 20m. keeping an eye on preemption events.

Jun (Kestrel): nice, that improvement looks good. can you also whitelist two IPs from our evaluation runners so retries don't get blocked by rate limits?

Ava CS: noted — send the IPs in a DM or email to support-ips@redwood.ai and i'll attach them to the kestrel allowlist.

Ava CS: next steps: 1) i'll compile a short usage + cost note for Kestrel (ETA: EOD PST) 2) Marco to keep metric watch until 06:00 UTC 3) schedule a 30-min handoff with Kestrel on Mon to discuss commit bump if onboarding load repeats.

Jun (Kestrel): sounds good. ping me for the handoff invite. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled ephemeral burst (id: eb-7862) started at 2026-03-20T02:46Z, ttl 90m.

Ava CS: closing this thread after handoff unless anything else shows up. leaving action items in the ticket (CS-2148). :white_check_mark:
